annotations.text: Start here. Read from the live stylesheet, then measured against Germania Automotriz and Full Paint Perú in Lima plus premium paint shops abroad.

A · Taller — dark industrial.
Near-black ground, condensed uppercase Barlow, brand red, zero radius. Paintwork only reads when there is something for it to reflect, and dark gives it that.
Tradeoff: heavy over a long informational page, and the quote wizard has to be redrawn dark to match.

B · Ficha técnica — light and measured.
Steel neutrals, IBM Plex Sans and Mono, deep oxide red, every value a labelled field. Puts the online quote in the hero, which is the thing no competitor here offers.
Tradeoff: cooler and less emotional. It wins trust rather than desire, and the least work to retrofit.

C · Obra — editorial, work-led.
Paper ground, Bodoni Moda display, jobs numbered like case studies. Reads expensive in the way a restoration shop does.
Tradeoff: it lives or dies on photography that does not exist yet, and it reads costlier than a budget customer wants.
